svg.title: Images Come Back at Once; Video Is a Job
svg.desc: Image lane: a prompt goes to images.generate on a GPT-image deployment, which returns base64 in data[0].b64_json, not a URL; decode it and write the bytes to a file. Image edit with a mask changes only part of an image. dall-e-3 was retired on 4 March 2026. Video lane with Sora: create a job, poll its status until the job finishes, then download the video.
svg.text: Images Come Back at Once; Video Is a Job
Decode the image's base64 and save it; for video, create a job, poll it, then download.
